papers.title: Fine-mapping HLA-II haplotypes in Alzheimer's disease and healthy longevity reveals distinct associations with microglial HLA-II load and neuropathology
papers.translated_title: 在阿尔茨海默病和健康长寿中对HLA-II单倍型进行精细定位，揭示了其与小胶质细胞HLA-II负荷和神经病理学的不同关联。
papers.author: Alvarez Sirvent, D.
papers.summary: Human leukocyte antigen (HLA) class II variation is implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and longevity, but its mechanisms within the major histocompatibility complex remain unclear. We fine-mapped seven independent HLA-II haplotypes in 6,053 individuals (443 cognitively healthy centenarians [CHCs], 3,219 population controls, 2,391 AD patients). Three haplotypes overlapped previous AD and lifespan signals. Hap-B (DRB1*04subtypes) was protective, enriched in CHCs and controls versus AD, with its neuroprotective association with tau pathology replicated in an independent Netherlands Brain Bank cohort. Hap-R (DRB1*01:01) increased AD risk and reduced healthy longevity, with reduced microglial HLA-II activation. Hap-Y (DRB1*15:01) showed increased microglial HLA-II activation in post-mortem brain tissue, independent of quantitative AD neuropathology. These findings indicate distinct HLA-II haplotypes shape AD susceptibility and healthy longevity through separate mechanisms, linking HLA architecture to brain immune states beyond classical neuropathology.
papers.translated_summary: 人类白细胞抗原（HLA）II类变异与阿尔茨海默病（AD）和长寿相关，但其在主要组织相容性复合体内部的作用机制仍不清楚。我们对6，053名个体（443名认知健康百岁老人[CHC]、3，219名人群对照、2，391名AD患者）中的七个独立HLA-II单倍型进行了精细定位。三个单倍型与既往AD和寿命信号重叠。Hap-B（DRB1*04亚型）具有保护作用，在CHC和对照中较AD富集，其与tau病理的神经保护关联在一个独立的荷兰脑库队列中得到了重复验证。Hap-R（DRB1*01:01）增加AD风险并降低健康长寿，同时伴有小胶质细胞HLA-II激活减少。Hap-Y（DRB1*15:01）在死后脑组织中显示小胶质细胞HLA-II激活增加，且独立于定量AD神经病理。这些发现表明，不同的HLA-II单倍型通过不同机制塑造AD易感性和健康长寿，将HLA结构与超越经典神经病理的脑免疫状态联系起来。

papers.title: Machine Learning-Supported Efficient VTE Risk Assessment using Routinely Collected Electronic Health Record Data
papers.translated_title: 机器学习支持的利用常规收集的电子健康记录数据进行高效VTE风险评估
papers.author: Li, Z.
papers.summary: Objective: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a leading cause of preventable inpatient mortality, while the real-world performance of mandated risk assessment and the potential for automating using electronic health record (EHR) data remain unclear. We evaluated completion, concordance with structured EHR data, clinical validity, and feasibility of EHR-supported VTE risk assessment assisted by machine learning. Materials and Methods: We analysed 577,904 admissions and 726,896 VTE assessment forms across five NHS hospitals between 2015 and 2025. Concordance and clinical validity were evaluated in 87,118 completed assessments from 2023 to 2024. Machine learning models compared clinician-recorded and EHR-derived risk factors in 74,372 encounters with an assessment completed within 14 hours of admission. Results: Overall completion was 96.7%, and timely completion improved from 47.4% in 2015 to 90.5% in 2024. Agreement between forms and EHR data was good for common risk factors (e.g. age over 60 years: precision 0.95, recall 0.77), but low-prevalence variables were often under-documented in the forms (e.g. critical care admission: precision 0.20, recall 0.14). Despite these discrepancies, form-derived thrombosis risk was associated with increased VTE incidence (adjusted OR 3.31, 95% CI 2.81-3.90). Models using EHR-derived factors available within 14 hours achieved an AUROC of 0.709, compared with 0.704 for clinician-recorded variables. Discussion: Much of the information the risk assessment requires already exists in structured EHR data, and EHR-derived variables contained discriminative information comparable to that in clinician-recorded factors. Conclusion: Routinely collected EHR data could support real-time pre-population of structured VTE assessments, thereby reducing documentation burden while preserving clinical validity.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：静脉血栓栓塞症（VTE）是可预防的住院死亡的主要原因之一，而强制性风险评估在真实世界中的执行情况以及利用电子健康记录（EHR）数据实现自动化的潜力仍不明确。我们评估了由机器学习辅助的、EHR支持的VTE风险评估的完成率、与结构化EHR数据的一致性、临床有效性及可行性。材料与方法：我们分析了2015年至2025年间五家NHS医院的577,904例入院记录和726,896份VTE评估表。在2023年至2024年的87,118份已完成评估中评价了一致性和临床有效性。机器学习模型在74,372例于入院14小时内完成评估的病例中，比较了临床医生记录的危险因素与EHR衍生的危险因素。结果：总体完成率为96.7%，及时完成率从2015年的47.4%提高至2024年的90.5%。评估表与EHR数据在常见危险因素上的一致性良好（例如年龄超过60岁：精确率0.95，召回率0.77），但低患病率变量在评估表中常记录不足（例如重症监护入院：精确率0.20，召回率0.14）。尽管存在这些差异，评估表衍生的血栓风险仍与VTE发生率升高相关（校正OR 3.31，95% CI 2.81-3.90）。使用入院14小时内可获得的EHR衍生因素的模型达到AUROC 0.709，而临床医生记录变量的模型为0.704。讨论：风险评估所需的大部分信息已存在于结构化EHR数据中，且EHR衍生变量所含的判别信息与临床医生记录因素相当。结论：常规收集的EHR数据可支持结构化VTE评估的实时预填充，从而在保持临床有效性的同时减轻记录负担。

papers.title: HPV binding antibodies are associated with protection: a meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: HPV结合抗体与保护作用相关：一项荟萃分析
papers.author: Berry, M. T.
papers.summary: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the major cause of cervical cancer globally. Current vaccines have shown high efficacy at preventing HPV infection and other surrogate disease endpoints in randomised controlled trials (RCT). However, uptake is limited by accessibility and cost. Rapid clinical evaluation is critical for shortening time-to-market and encouraging the development and deployment of affordable vaccines. We aim to establish a validated correlate of protection that will support vaccine developers and decision makers with vaccine development, approval, dose schedules and deployment decisions. Methods: We utilised three existing Cochrane Systematic Reviews of RCTs of HPV vaccines and extended these to 1st January 2026. We identified and extracted data from trials where both efficacy and immunogenicity (HPV-specific antibodies) were reported. For HPV types where vaccine efficacy was reported but not immunogenicity (Types 31/33/45/52/58) we sourced antibody binding concentrations from separate immunogenicity studies. We linked antibody binding concentrations from each RCT to the corresponding vaccine efficacy data, matching by study, vaccine arm, number of doses, and HPV type. We use a Bayesian framework in a model-based meta-analysis to examine the association between antibody binding concentrations and vaccine efficacy. Findings: Combining data on both vaccine-targeted and non-targeted HPV types, we find an association between type-specific antibody binding concentrations and vaccine efficacy against the three HPV outcomes tested: incident infection, persistent infection and grade 2 or 3 cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2+) (p<0.0005, for all outcomes). We also compared this association with data from studies of natural infection, which had shown an association between antibody binding concentrations and risk of infection. This demonstrated that the association between vaccine-induced antibodies and vaccine efficacy was well aligned with the existing HPV literature on correlates of risk from natural exposure. Finally, we find evidence that the antibody concentrations associated with 50% (of the maximal) vaccine efficacy differ by type (p<0.0005, for example 16 sIU/ml for HPV58, but <0.5 IU/ml for HPV 16/18). Interpretations: HPV type-specific antibody binding concentrations are associated with protection against HPV related clinical outcomes, across different HPV types and vaccines, and after natural infection. The consistent observation that antibody binding concentrations correlate with protection provides support for the use of antibody binding for immunobridging, for example in non-inferiority studies when assessing similar vaccines. Funding: This work is supported by National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia and the University of New South Wales.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是全球宫颈癌的主要病因。现有疫苗在随机对照试验（RCT）中已显示出在预防HPV感染及其他替代疾病终点方面具有高效力。然而，其接种普及受到可及性和成本的限制。快速临床评估对于缩短上市时间、鼓励可负担疫苗的开发和部署至关重要。我们旨在建立经过验证的保护相关因素，以支持疫苗开发者和决策者在疫苗开发、审批、剂量方案和部署决策方面的工作。方法：我们利用了三个现有的Cochrane系统评价（针对HPV疫苗的RCT），并将其数据扩展至2026年1月1日。我们从同时报告效力（efficacy）和免疫原性（HPV特异性抗体）的试验中识别并提取数据。对于报告了疫苗效力但未报告免疫原性的HPV型别（31/33/45/52/58型），我们从单独的免疫原性研究中获取抗体结合浓度。我们将每项RCT中的抗体结合浓度与相应的疫苗效力数据相关联，按研究、疫苗组别、剂次和HPV型别进行匹配。我们采用基于模型的荟萃分析中的贝叶斯框架，检验抗体结合浓度与疫苗效力之间的关联。结果：结合疫苗靶向和非靶向HPV型别的数据，我们发现型特异性抗体结合浓度与针对三种HPV结局的疫苗效力之间存在关联：新发感染、持续性感染和2级或3级宫颈上皮内瘤变（CIN2+）（所有结局p<0.0005）。我们还将这一关联与自然感染研究的数据进行了比较，后者已显示抗体结合浓度与感染风险之间存在关联。这表明疫苗诱导抗体与疫苗效力之间的关联与现有关于自然暴露风险相关因素的HPV文献高度一致。最后，我们发现证据表明，与50%（最大）疫苗效力相关的抗体浓度因型别而异（p<0.0005，例如HPV58为16 sIU/ml，而HPV 16/18为<0.5 IU/ml）。解释：HPV型特异性抗体结合浓度与针对HPV相关临床结局的保护作用相关，且这一关联跨越不同HPV型别和疫苗，并在自然感染后同样成立。抗体结合浓度与保护作用相关这一一致性观察结果，为使用抗体结合进行免疫桥接提供了支持，例如在评估类似疫苗的非劣效性研究中。资助：本工作由澳大利亚国家健康与医学研究委员会和新南威尔士大学资助。

papers.title: Expression of specific var gene subtypes is associated with distinct severe malaria syndromes
papers.translated_title: 特定var基因亚型的表达与不同的重症疟疾综合征相关
papers.author: Ndugwa, H.
papers.summary: The virulence of Plasmodium falciparum is closely linked to P. falciparum erythrocyte membrane protein 1 (PfEMP1), encoded by the diverse var gene family. PfEMP1 mediates parasite immune evasion and vascular adhesion of infected red blood cells, contributing to severe disease. While expression of group A or domain cassette (DC8 and DC13)-containing var genes have been associated with severe malaria, direct comparisons between the severe malaria syndromes remain limited. Furthermore, interactions between specific var gene expression and the rosetting phenotype, a known marker of severe malaria, are incompletely understood across severe malaria syndromes. We analysed parasite and clinical data from 966 Kenyan children with non-severe malaria and severe malaria syndromes collected over 18 years in Kilifi, Kenya. Var gene transcription was profiled using DBL-tag sequencing (n=898), RT-qPCR (n=768), and DBL-tag-based prediction tools. We show that parasites expressing group A or DC8 var genes were associated with impaired consciousness (IC), while rosetting was associated with respiratory distress (RD) and severe malarial anaemia (SMA), but not IC. Variant expression was more homogeneous in SMA than IC or RD. These findings suggest that IC, RD and SMA reflect distinct underlying parasite virulence strategies: sequestration, rosetting associated parasite virulence, and chronicity of infection respectively. In conclusion, this analysis provides the most comprehensive characterisation of P. falciparum var gene expression across the major severe malaria syndromes to date and highlights the possibility of syndrome-specific parasite virulence mechanisms that may inform the development of targeted therapeutic interventions
papers.translated_summary: 恶性疟原虫的毒力与恶性疟原虫红细胞膜蛋白1（PfEMP1）密切相关，后者由高度多样的var基因家族编码。PfEMP1介导寄生虫免疫逃逸及感染红细胞的血管黏附，从而导致重症疾病。尽管A组或含结构域盒（DC8和DC13）的var基因表达与重症疟疾相关，但不同重症疟疾综合征之间的直接比较仍有限。此外，特定var基因表达与玫瑰花结形成表型（重症疟疾的已知标志）之间的相互作用在不同重症疟疾综合征中尚未完全阐明。我们分析了在肯尼亚基利菲地区历时18年收集的966名肯尼亚儿童（非重症疟疾和重症疟疾综合征）的寄生虫及临床数据。采用DBL-tag测序（n=898）、RT-qPCR（n=768）及基于DBL-tag的预测工具对var基因转录进行图谱分析。我们发现，表达A组或DC8 var基因的寄生虫与意识受损（IC）相关，而玫瑰花结形成与呼吸窘迫（RD）和重症疟疾贫血（SMA）相关，但与IC无关。SMA中的变异体表达比IC或RD更为均一。这些发现提示，IC、RD和SMA分别反映了不同的潜在寄生虫毒力策略：隔离、玫瑰花结形成相关的寄生虫毒力以及感染的慢性化。总之，本分析提供了迄今为止对主要重症疟疾综合征中恶性疟原虫var基因表达最为全面的表征，并揭示了综合征特异性寄生虫毒力机制的可能性，这可能为靶向治疗干预措施的开发提供依据。

papers.title: WITHDRAWN: How to Detect the Early Cardiac Functional Change and Predict Heart Failure in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation? A Prospective Cohort Study
papers.translated_title: 已撤回：如何检测阵发性心房颤动中的早期心脏功能变化并预测心力衰竭？一项前瞻性队列研究
papers.author: Cheng, L.
papers.summary: Backgrounds20-30% atrial fibrillation (AF) may result in heart failure (HF). Noninvasive left ventricle myocardial work (LVMW) is a fairly new method for detecting LV function. We aimed to evaluate whether LVMW could detect the LV change function in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF) and predict HF incident. MethodsIn this prospective cohort study, 146 PAF subjects and 63 non-PAF subjects matched by age and gender set as the controls were enrolled. Noninvasive LVMW parameters, including global work index, global constructive work, global wasted work (GWW) and global work efficiency (GWE) were obtained from LV pressure-strain loop by 2D speckle tracking imaging. LA volume index (LAVI) was measured by 3D echocardiography. AF burden (AFB) was evaluated by questionnaire. The primary outcome was the incident HF.AFB deterioration was evaluated at the end of follow up. Stata15.0 and R4.1 were used for data analysis and description. ResultsThe average age was 66.2{+/-}11.4 years and comprised 55% males in PAF. Compared with the controls, PAF had significantly elevated GWW (143.7{+/-}88.3mmHg% vs 115.5{+/-}59.6mmHg%, p<0.001) and impaired GWE (92.3{+/-}7.5% vs 93.8{+/-}2.8%, p=0.035) and they were correlated with increased LAVImax and LAVImin. Those with higher AFB showed significantly decreased LAEF and increased LAVImin. During the average 40.5 months follow-up, 9.9% PAF developed HF and ablation reduced the HF occurrence. In the non-ablation subgroup, baseline decreased LAEF rather than LVMW was a strong predictor for HF. As expected, AFB deterioration was strongly associated with HF incident. ConclusionsElevated GWW was detected by LVMW and it was strongly correlated with LA dilation in PAF. Higher AFB had adverse effect on LAVImin. Restoring sinus rhythm was significant for HF prevention, especially for PAF with lower LAEF. Clinical PerspectiveO_ST_ABSWhat is new?C_ST_ABSO_LIAlthough GLS and LVEF remained normal, subtle LV dysfunction of elevated GWW and impaired GWE could be detected by LVMW in the early stage of PAF. C_LIO_LIIncreased LAVImin, rather than LAEF, was strongly associated with elevated GWW and higher AF burden in PAF. C_LIO_LIRestoring sinus rhythm was important to early stage of PAF for HF prevention, especially in PAF with lower LAEF. C_LI What are the clinical implications?O_LIIt is significant for PAF to protect LV function by maintaining sinus rhythm or keeping AFB at minimal-mild stage, even from the very early stage. C_LIO_LIIncreased LAVImin is an important indicator for detecting LV dysfunction in PAF and the underlying mechanism needs to be discovered. C_LI
papers.translated_summary: 背景：20-30%的房颤（AF）可能导致心力衰竭（HF）。无创左心室心肌做功（LVMW）是一种检测左心室功能的新方法。我们旨在评估LVMW是否能检测阵发性房颤（PAF）的左心室功能变化并预测HF发生。方法：在这项前瞻性队列研究中，纳入146例PAF受试者和63例按年龄和性别匹配的非PAF受试者作为对照组。通过二维斑点追踪成像从左心室压力-应变环获取无创LVMW参数，包括整体做功指数、整体 constructive work、整体无效做功（GWW）和整体做功效率（GWE）。通过三维超声心动图测量左心房容积指数（LAVI）。通过问卷评估房颤负荷（AFB）。主要结局为新发HF。在随访结束时评估AFB恶化。使用Stata15.0和R4.1进行数据分析和描述。结果：PAF组平均年龄为66.2±11.4岁，男性占55%。与对照组相比，PAF组的GWW显著升高（143.7±88.3mmHg% vs 115.5±59.6mmHg%，p<0.001），GWE受损（92.3±7.5% vs 93.8±2.8%，p=0.035），且它们与LAVImax和LAVImin增加相关。AFB较高的患者左心房射血分数（LAEF）显著降低，LAVImin增加。在平均40.5个月的随访期间，9.9%的PAF患者发生HF，消融降低了HF发生率。在非消融亚组中，基线LAEF降低而非LVMW是HF的强预测因子。正如预期，AFB恶化与HF发生密切相关。结论：LVMW检测到GWW升高，且其与PAF中的左心房扩张密切相关。较高的AFB对LAVImin有不良影响。恢复窦性心律对预防HF具有重要意义，尤其是对于LAEF较低的PAF患者。临床视角：有什么新发现？尽管整体纵向应变（GLS）和左心室射血分数（LVEF）仍正常，但在PAF早期，LVMW可检测到GWW升高和GWE受损所反映的细微左心室功能障碍。LAVImin增加而非LAEF与PAF中GWW升高和较高房颤负荷密切相关。恢复窦性心律对早期PAF预防HF很重要，尤其是LAEF较低的PAF患者。临床意义是什么？对于PAF患者，即使从非常早期阶段开始，通过维持窦性心律或将AFB保持在最小-轻度阶段来保护左心室功能具有重要意义。LAVImin增加是检测PAF左心室功能障碍的重要指标，其潜在机制有待发现。

papers.title: Agreement between an artificial intelligence video-analysis platform and human evaluators scoring emergency medical technician psychomotor skills: a fully crossed reliability study
papers.translated_title: 人工智能视频分析平台与人类评估者在紧急医疗技术员精神运动技能评分上的一致性：一项完全交叉可靠性研究
papers.author: Otte, J. H.
papers.summary: BackgroundA primary constraint on the capacity of EMS programs to meet industry demand is psychomotor instruction and verification--requiring direct observation of each student by a qualified evaluator. Whether AI video analysis can relieve it is untested; none has been applied to EMS skill examination or compared with human examiners. ObjectiveTo quantify human EMS evaluator inter-rater reliability and evaluate an AI video-analysis platform against it. MethodsIn a prospective, fully crossed study, five certified EMS evaluators and an AI platform independently scored identical video-recorded EMT performances of cervical collar application (n=15), bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilation (n=14), and medical assessment (n=15) on dichotomous checklists with critical-failure criteria. Agreement was assessed at item, score, and decision levels using Fleiss {kappa}, Krippendorffs , Gwets AC1, and ICC(2,1)/ICC(2,k). ResultsHuman item agreement was moderate ({kappa} 0.409-0.467), as was single-rater reliability (ICC(2,1) 0.539-0.694), against good panel reliability (ICC(2,k) 0.854-0.919). Recorded pass/fail agreement was fair ({kappa} 0.297-0.388) and critical-failure agreement near zero for two skills ({kappa} 0.028, 0.119). AI alignment tracked rubric observability rather than task complexity: r = 0.857 (collar, exceeding every human), -0.173 (BVM), 0.664 (medical), and it was most lenient on two skills. ConclusionsHuman evaluators are an imperfect standard, especially on critical failures. The AI was a legitimate additional rater where checklist items were discrete and visually verifiable, but not where credit required judging continuous quantities such as ventilation rate, volume, or suction duration. Defensible uses are formative and archival, not summative. These results reflect an early, non-specialist configuration--a baseline, not a limit.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：EMS项目满足行业需求的能力受到一个主要制约，即精神运动技能教学与验证——需要由合格评估者对每位学生进行直接观察。AI视频分析能否缓解这一制约尚未得到检验；尚无此类技术被应用于EMS技能考核或与人类评估者进行比较。目的：量化人类EMS评估者之间的评分者间信度，并评估一个AI视频分析平台相对于该信度的表现。方法：在一项前瞻性、完全交叉研究中，五名认证EMS评估者和一个AI平台独立对相同的视频录制EMT操作表现进行评分，包括颈托应用（n=15）、球囊面罩（BVM）通气（n=14）和医学评估（n=15），使用具有关键失败标准的二分法核查表。在条目、分数和决策层面，使用Fleiss κ、Krippendorff α、Gwet AC1和ICC(2,1)/ICC(2,k)评估一致性。结果：人类条目一致性为中等（κ 0.409-0.467），单评分者信度也为中等（ICC(2,1) 0.539-0.694），而小组信度为良好（ICC(2,k) 0.854-0.919）。记录的通过/不通过一致性为一般（κ 0.297-0.388），两项技能的关键失败一致性接近零（κ 0.028，0.119）。AI对齐程度更多反映评分标准的可观察性，而非任务复杂性：r = 0.857（颈托，超过所有人类），-0.173（BVM），0.664（医学评估），并且它在两项技能上最为宽松。结论：人类评估者是一个不完美的标准，尤其是在关键失败方面。在核查表条目离散且视觉可验证的情况下，AI是一个合理的额外评分者，但在评分需要判断连续量（如通气频率、潮气量或吸引持续时间）的情况下则不然。可辩护的用途是形成性和存档性，而非终结性。这些结果反映的是一个早期、非专科配置——是基线，而非极限。

papers.title: Prevalence of Enteric Hyperoxaluria in Crohn's Disease, Cystic Fibrosis, and After Bariatric Surgery: A Systematic Review
papers.translated_title: 克罗恩病、囊性纤维化及减重手术后肠源性高草酸尿症的患病率：一项系统综述
papers.author: Xing, X.
papers.summary: Abstract Background. Enteric hyperoxaluria (EH) causes calcium oxalate kidney stones, oxalate nephropathy, and chronic kidney disease (CKD), and can progress to end-stage kidney disease. It occurs in Crohn's disease (CD), cystic fibrosis (CF), chronic pancreatitis, celiac disease, short bowel syndrome, and after bariatric surgery. Its prevalence in these populations has not been synthesized. Methods. PROSPERO CRD420261364424. PubMed and Embase were searched to 24 August 2026 for studies reporting 24-hour urinary oxalate. Prevalence was pooled using the Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation with a DerSimonian-Laird random-effects model; unweighted crude prevalence is also reported. Because heterogeneity was high, the narrative synthesis stratified by testing condition is the primary result. Prespecified subgroups addressed oxalate load before collection, diagnostic threshold, ileal resection, age, and urine collection format. Results. Forty-seven studies were included. In CD (17 studies, 471 patients; 204 with EH), crude prevalence was 43.3% and pooled prevalence 49.3% (95% CI 38.9-59.8; I^2 = 95.3%). With an oxalate load, prevalence was 64.7% (pooled 74.0%, 55.9-88.6) versus 38.6% without (pooled 39.1%, 28.7-50.0). Among CD patients, EH was more frequent with ileal resection (48.8% vs 31.7%; OR 1.62, 0.91-2.89) and with steatorrhea (62.5% vs 29.3%; OR 9.88, 3.81-25.61). In CF (7 studies, 348 patients; 179 with EH), pooled prevalence was 49.8% (40.5-59.1; I^2 = 91.9%). After bariatric surgery (15 studies, 849 patients; 474 with EH), pooled prevalence was 54.7% (45.4-63.9; I^2 = 96.7%). Conclusions. Roughly half of these patients have EH, but the proportion depends heavily on whether an oxalate load precedes urine collection (39% unprovoked vs 65%-74% provoked); because most studies do not state this condition, published prevalence estimates are not directly comparable. Ileal resection and steatorrhea identify those who should be screened.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景。肠源性高草酸尿症（EH）可引起草酸钙肾结石、草酸盐肾病和慢性肾脏病（CKD），并可进展为终末期肾病。它发生于克罗恩病（CD）、囊性纤维化（CF）、慢性胰腺炎、乳糜泻、短肠综合征以及减重手术后。其在这些人群中的患病率尚未得到综合。方法。PROSPERO CRD420261364424。检索了PubMed和Embase至2026年8月24日，纳入报告24小时尿草酸盐的研究。采用Freeman-Tukey双反正弦变换结合DerSimonian-Laird随机效应模型合并患病率；同时报告未加权的粗患病率。由于异质性较高，按检测条件分层的叙述性综合为主要结果。预设亚组涉及采集前草酸盐负荷、诊断阈值、回肠切除、年龄和尿液采集形式。结果。共纳入47项研究。在CD中（17项研究，471例患者；204例患EH），粗患病率为43.3%，合并患病率为49.3%（95% CI 38.9-59.8；I^2 = 95.3%）。在有草酸盐负荷时，患病率为64.7%（合并74.0%，55.9-88.6），而无草酸盐负荷时为38.6%（合并39.1%，28.7-50.0）。在CD患者中，EH在回肠切除后更为常见（48.8% vs 31.7%；OR 1.62，0.91-2.89），在脂肪泻时也更为常见（62.5% vs 29.3%；OR 9.88，3.81-25.61）。在CF中（7项研究，348例患者；179例患EH），合并患病率为49.8%（40.5-59.1；I^2 = 91.9%）。减重手术后（15项研究，849例患者；474例患EH），合并患病率为54.7%（45.4-63.9；I^2 = 96.7%）。结论。这些患者中约有一半患有EH，但该比例在很大程度上取决于尿液采集前是否有草酸盐负荷（无激发时为39%，激发时为65%-74%）；由于大多数研究未说明这一条件，已发表的患病率估计值无法直接比较。回肠切除和脂肪泻可识别出应接受筛查的患者。

papers.title: Ecological momentary assessments predict clinical anxiety and depression status at 3 months post-stroke
papers.translated_title: 生态瞬时评估可预测卒中后3个月时的临床焦虑和抑郁状态
papers.author: Duttagupta, S.
papers.summary: Background: Stroke survivors frequently experience post-stroke depression (PSD) and post-stroke anxiety (PSA), which may be underexamined by clinicians if patient mood status between discharge and follow-up is unknown. Digital monitoring may enable early identification of mood disturbances. Ecological momentary assessments (EMA) have been tested to capture mood fluctuations in patients regular environments, but no standardized procedure for monitoring PSA or PSD has been developed. Objective: Determine the feasibility and validity of EMA for evaluating subacute PSA and PSD in non-severe stroke patients. Methods: Patients with non-severe stroke discharged home responded to daily smartphone EMA questions concerning mood and activity for twelve weeks until follow-up. Questions based on symptoms of anxiety and depression were used to derive EMA Anx and EMA Dep indices, computed over five 15-day intervals. Convergent validity was assessed using follow-up Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) and Centre for Epidemiological Studies-Depression (CES-D) scores. Logistic regression models predicted PSA and PSD status at follow-up, with baseline models comprising stroke severity, age, sex, and mood status, to which EMA Anx or Dep were added. Results: Data from 118 patients were analyzed. EMA adherence was moderate, with 89 patients (75.4%) responding on 75 or more days. Correlations between EMA Anx and GAD-7 and between EMA Dep and CES-D generally strengthened at later intervals, with the average mood index generally showing the strongest associations. Adding EMA data from the third time interval (31-45 days) significantly improved model fit beyond the baseline models (Anxiety: {chi}-square = 7.08, p = 0.008, {delta}R-square = 0.060; Depression: {chi}-square = 28.0, p < 0.001, {delta}R-square = 0.256). Discussion: EMA is feasible in mild-to-moderate stroke patients and may facilitate early identification of post-stroke mood disturbances. Further analyses in more diverse populations are required to validate these findings.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：卒中幸存者常出现卒中后抑郁（PSD）和卒中后焦虑（PSA），若患者出院至随访期间的情绪状态未知，临床医生可能对这些情况评估不足。数字化监测可能有助于早期识别情绪障碍。生态瞬时评估（EMA）已被用于捕捉患者在日常环境中的情绪波动，但目前尚未开发出用于监测PSA或PSD的标准化流程。目的：确定EMA用于评估非重症卒中患者亚急性期PSA和PSD的可行性及有效性。方法：非重症卒中出院回家的患者连续十二周每日通过智能手机回答有关情绪和活动的EMA问题，直至随访。基于焦虑和抑郁症状的问题用于推导EMA Anx和EMA Dep指数，分别在五个15天区间内计算。采用随访时的广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7（GAD-7）和流行病学研究中心抑郁量表（CES-D）评分评估聚合效度。使用逻辑回归模型预测随访时的PSA和PSD状态，基线模型包括卒中严重程度、年龄、性别和情绪状态，随后加入EMA Anx或Dep。结果：分析了118例患者的数据。EMA依从性为中等，89例患者（75.4%）在75天或更长时间内作答。EMA Anx与GAD-7之间以及EMA Dep与CES-D之间的相关性通常在较晚区间增强，平均情绪指数通常显示出最强的关联。加入第三个时间区间（31-45天）的EMA数据后，模型拟合显著优于基线模型（焦虑：{chi}-square = 7.08，p = 0.008，{delta}R-square = 0.060；抑郁：{chi}-square = 28.0，p < 0.001，{delta}R-square = 0.256）。讨论：EMA在轻至中度卒中患者中可行，并可能有助于早期识别卒中后情绪障碍。需要在更多样化的人群中进一步分析以验证这些发现。

papers.title: Navigating Life After Dementia Diagnosis: Questions, Challenges, and Support Needs Among Dementia Dyads
papers.translated_title: 痴呆症诊断后的生活导航：痴呆症二人组合的问题、挑战和支持需求
papers.author: Britt, K.
papers.summary: Background: Older adults living with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (AD/ADRD) and their care partners face substantial daily challenges that evolve with disease progression and extend far beyond the clinical setting, including symptom management, care coordination, healthcare navigation, and planning for future care needs. Understanding these challenges is essential for developing innovative solutions to provide ongoing and targeted support. In this study, we explored questions, challenges, and support needs experienced by dementia dyads following diagnosis to inform the development of an artificial intelligence (AI)-based chatbot designed to provide ongoing support for dementia dyads. Methods: We recruited 11 community-dwelling dyads comprising persons living with MCI or mild AD/ADRD and their care partners, one additional care partner, and 12 dementia care experts from academic medical centers, clinics, and aging organizations in the U.S. We conducted semi-structured interviews and analyzed them using conventional content analysis. Results: Participants described interconnected questions, challenges, and support needs that evolved while navigating life with MCI or AD/ADRD. Questions centered around day-to-day care management, medical concerns, behavioral symptom management, diagnosis and prognosis, safety, and resources and services. Challenges included care partner overwhelm, limited dementia knowledge, condition-related uncertainty, healthcare system navigation difficulties, financial constraints, and technology-related barriers. Participants identified needs for ongoing education, personalized care planning, resource navigation, logistical support and follow-up, culturally responsive care, and social and emotional support. Conclusions: Dementia dyads experience substantial informational, emotional, and practical support needs in the early stages of MCI and AD/ADRD. Findings suggest that post-diagnostic support should extend beyond information provision alone to provide ongoing, personalized, and practical guidance that helps dyads navigate changing needs, resources, and everyday dementia care. These findings are informing the development of an AI-based chatbot intended to complement existing dementia care by extending access to education, practical guidance, and resource navigation between clinical encounters.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：患有轻度认知障碍（MCI）或阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（AD/ADRD）的老年人及其照护伙伴面临着巨大的日常挑战，这些挑战随着疾病进展而演变，并远远超出临床环境，包括症状管理、照护协调、医疗保健导航以及未来照护需求的规划。理解这些挑战对于开发创新解决方案以提供持续且有针对性支持至关重要。在本研究中，我们探讨了痴呆症二元组在诊断后所经历的问题、挑战和支持需求，以指导开发一款基于人工智能（AI）的聊天机器人，旨在为痴呆症二元组提供持续支持。方法：我们招募了11个社区居住的二元组，包括患有MCI或轻度AD/ADRD的人及其照护伙伴，另招募了1名照护伙伴，以及来自美国学术医疗中心、诊所和老龄化组织的12名痴呆症照护专家。我们进行了半结构化访谈，并使用传统内容分析法对其进行分析。结果：参与者描述了在应对MCI或AD/ADRD生活过程中不断演变且相互关联的问题、挑战和支持需求。问题集中在日常照护管理、医疗问题、行为症状管理、诊断和预后、安全以及资源和服务方面。挑战包括照护伙伴不堪重负、痴呆症知识有限、与疾病相关的不确定性、医疗保健系统导航困难、经济限制以及技术相关障碍。参与者确定了持续教育、个性化照护规划、资源导航、后勤支持和随访、文化响应性照护以及社交和情感支持的需求。结论：痴呆症二元组在MCI和AD/ADRD早期阶段经历了大量信息、情感和实践支持需求。研究结果表明，诊断后支持不应仅限于提供信息，而应提供持续、个性化和实用的指导，帮助二元组应对不断变化的需求、资源和日常痴呆症照护。这些发现正在指导开发一款基于AI的聊天机器人，旨在通过扩大临床就诊之间的教育、实用指导和资源导航的可及性，来补充现有的痴呆症照护。

papers.title: Learning-by-Doing to Adapt a Digital Community Engagement Strategy for Identifying and Reaching Zero-Dose Children in Kano State, Nigeria: A Program Case Study
papers.translated_title: 在尼日利亚卡诺州，通过边做边学调整数字社区参与策略以识别和覆盖零剂次儿童：一个项目案例研究
papers.author: Ahmad K.U Nagogo, A.
papers.summary: Background: Kano State has one of the highest concentrations of zero-dose (ZD) children in Nigeria, challenging equitable immunization coverage. Digital engagement tools meant to strengthen timely data to address such gaps often underperform due to limited adaptability to user needs. Learning-by-doing (LxD), which brings together human-centered design and adaptive management, offers more context-responsive solutions. Intervention and Implementation Approach: MCH-Track, a digital platform for tracking and referral for childhood vaccinations was used by 56 female community mobilizers in two local government areas (LGAs) out of the 44 LGAs in Kano State, Nigeria. We conducted a program case study from: 1) August 2024-April 2025 (initial implementation); and 2) adapted implementation (May 2025-November 2025), where LxD was incorporated to address emergent challenges. LxD included structured shadowing, monthly interviews with users, after-action reviews, and change log to track adaptations alongside routine services. Performance was monitored using four indicators: feedback actioned, response time-to-user feedback, ease-of-use score, and mobilizer performance in tracking ZD children. Findings: After incorporating LxD, 17 issues were identified and led to 12 prioritized adaptations. All logged issues received responses, with median response time declining to approximately two weeks, while community mobilizers reported higher usability of the digital platform (e.g., mean ease-of-use score of 4.1 out of 5). Enhanced root-cause analysis enabled trend tracking and clearer escalation pathways for systemic issues like micro-stockouts at immunization points. Empathy tool records revealed mobilizer struggles with platform. This was immediately logged, prompting user experience redesign into a seamless, single-step process from registration-to-referral. During the LxD implementation period, an average of 33 ZD children per month were identified via MCH-Track, a substantial increase from the pre-LxD period (an average of 11 ZD children identified per month). Average referral-to-access rates also improved during the LxD period, rising from 44% of identified and referred ZD children accessing immunization services pre-LxD to 70% after incorporating LxD practices. Conclusion: Embedding LxD within MCH-Track strengthened co-creation, streamlined workflows, and improved community mobilizer performance, demonstrating the value of adaptive management in reaching ZD children.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：卡诺州是尼日利亚零剂次（ZD）儿童集中度最高的地区之一，为实现公平的免疫接种覆盖带来了挑战。旨在加强及时数据以弥补此类缺口的数字参与工具往往表现不佳，原因在于其对用户需求的适应性有限。边做边学（LxD）将以人为本的设计与适应性管理相结合，提供了更具情境响应性的解决方案。干预与实施方法：MCH-Track是一个用于儿童疫苗接种追踪和转介的数字平台，由尼日利亚卡诺州44个地方政府区域（LGA）中两个LGA的56名女性社区动员员使用。我们开展了一项项目案例研究，涵盖：1）2024年8月至2025年4月（初始实施阶段）；以及2）适应性实施阶段（2025年5月至2025年11月），在此期间引入LxD以应对新出现的挑战。LxD包括结构化跟随观察、每月用户访谈、行动后回顾以及变更日志，以在常规服务的同时追踪适应性调整。绩效通过四项指标进行监测：已处理的反馈、对用户反馈的响应时间、易用性评分以及动员员在追踪ZD儿童方面的表现。发现：在引入LxD后，共识别出17个问题，并促成了12项优先适应性调整。所有记录的问题均获得了回应，中位响应时间降至约两周，同时社区动员员报告数字平台的可用性有所提高（例如，平均易用性评分为4.1分，满分5分）。增强的根本原因分析使趋势追踪成为可能，并为免疫接种点微缺货等系统性问题提供了更清晰的升级路径。共情工具记录揭示了动员员在使用平台时遇到的困难。这些问题被立即记录，促使用户体验重新设计为从登记到转介的无缝单步流程。在LxD实施期间，通过MCH-Track平均每月识别出33名ZD儿童，较LxD实施前（平均每月识别11名ZD儿童）大幅增加。平均转介到接种率在LxD期间也有所改善，从LxD实施前已识别并转介的ZD儿童中获得免疫接种服务的44%上升至引入LxD实践后的70%。结论：将LxD嵌入MCH-Track加强了共同创造，简化了工作流程，并提升了社区动员员的表现，展示了适应性管理在覆盖ZD儿童方面的价值。
